To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the regional exposure to GLOFs of HPP in the Himalaya is high; (2) the uncertainty about GLOB peak discharges at HPP is highest in the headwaters, but it is lowest downstream; (3) the systematic push of HHP into headwaters effectively doubled the uncertainty about GOF peak discharges there.
